map.：浓度 35 落在断点档 [12.1, 35.4] → [51, 100]。\n:
: a concentration of 35 falls in the breakpoint band [12.1, 35.4] -> [51, 100].
AQI = (100-51)/(35.4-12.1) x (35-12.1) + 51 = 49/23.3 x 22.9 + 51 ≈ 48.2 + 51 = 99.2 -> 99 after rounding, which is "Good".
If the concentration is 150, it falls in [55.5, 150.4] -> [151, 200]: AQI = (200-151)/(150.4-55.5) x (150-55.5) + 151 ≈ 49/94.9 x 94.5 + 151 ≈ 199.8 -> 200, which is "Moderate pollution".
